free_tier_limits.correction: No official free-tier or GET usage-cap statement was located. Lever does publish a limit of 2 application POST requests per second.

rate_limits.correction: Application creation is limited to 2 POST requests per second; Lever warns that this limit may change without notice. No numeric limit is documented for listing GET requests.

cors.correction: restricted: CORS is supported only from the Lever customer's own domains and subdomains, not arbitrary origins

notes: The documented v0 endpoint remains operational in 2026, and the example currently returns JSON without authentication. No official shutdown or v0 deprecation notice was found. Pricing/free-tier language is not documented authoritatively, while CORS restrictions and the application POST rate limit are explicit.
